title: Enable PBO (Ryzen)
name: pbo-ryzen
modal: WARNING: Your PC will restart IMMEDIATELY into the BIOS/UEFI setup. Save all work first. PBO raises CPU clocks, heat and power draw. Make sure your cooling can handle it.
description: Reboots to BIOS to enable Precision Boost Overdrive on AMD Ryzen for higher CPU clocks
deepDescription:
Precision Boost Overdrive lifts AMD Ryzen power and clock limits for more FPS. Requires an AMD Ryzen CPU. This tweak reboots you into BIOS. Enable there:

- Precision Boost Overdrive → Enabled
- Limits → Motherboard

Watch CPU temperatures afterwards. Do not change anything else.
warning: PC restarts immediately. Save your work first.
